claims.statement: POST /api/library/session swaps a verified initData blob for an opaque cookie: 32 random base64url bytes stored in Redis as lib:sess:{token} with a 12-hour TTL, set as the nbq_lib HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie (Secure in production).
DELETE /api/library/session revokes the session server side by deleting the Redis key and clears the cookie.

Every routed request passes requireSession (cookie plus canOpenLibrary re-check), then requireStudent (403 with registered:false when unregistered), then requireReadableDocument (404 when missing or not live, 403 when the semester does not match).
mayReadDocument lives in src/services/library/entitlement.ts and allows the admin preview, otherwise requires a matching dept, regulation and year_sem; a null department always fails.
GET /subjects answers the admin preview of every live document unless ?view=roll is given, and groups documents into subjects by college code, sorted by code.

A page is served only when the page number is an integer within page_count and the rendered file exists, answered as image/svg+xml with no-store, inline disposition, nosniff and same-origin resource policy headers.
The watermark token is HMAC-SHA256 over 'nbk-library:{userId}' with the library secret, cut to eight hex characters and printed as NBK-XXXX-XXXX; the secret falls back to the bot token.

stampPage inserts a vector overlay before the closing svg tag with the token repeated diagonally at low opacity plus a footer line carrying the token and page label, and throws instead of serving a page that is not an SVG.
A served page records a library_reads row fire-and-forget and increments lib:reads:{userId} with a 300-second TTL, logging a warning past 300 pages; Redis failures never block the page.
